history.overview: The Rift Heart is the unstable planar core of the Sanctum, where rifts tear open into unknown realms and Discord energy surges uncontrollably.

timeline.name: Rift Heart Formation
timeline.description: A planar fracture expanded beyond containment, forming the Rift Heart.

timeline.name: Pylon Stabilization
timeline.description: Riftseekers installed pylons to slow planar collapse.

timeline.name: Discord Eruptions
timeline.description: Discord manifestations began emerging from unstable rifts.

timeline.name: Containment Rites
timeline.description: Riftseekers performed rituals to prevent total planar rupture.
